content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip provide user-friendly interfaces for selling digital products, but their limitations become apparent in restricted countries. These platforms rely heavily on payment processors that exclude many regions, effectively locking out creators from diverse markets. In contrast, COREMERCH’s sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a comprehensive solution that empowers creators with complete ownership and control over their sales. With features like automatic crypto payment processing and real-time product delivery, COREMERCH is built for the creators who refuse to be sidelined by payment exclusions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving the vast majority of the global population without access to its services. PayPal can suspend accounts for various reasons, holding funds for up to 180 days without appeal, creating uncertainty for creators. On the other hand, COREMERCH is designed specifically for those in restricted countries, providing a permanent alternative. By using decentralized payment methods like NOWPayments, which accepts over 300 cryptocurrencies, creators can sell their products without the fear of exclusion based on geography.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad charges a commission of 8.5% + $0.30 per transaction, while Payhip takes a 5% cut, both of which can be substantial for creators. Payment delays can also be an issue, with funds often held by platforms. Conversely, COREMERCH utilizes NOWPayments, which operates at a mere 0.5% fee, ensuring that creators receive their earnings swiftly and with minimal overhead. By leveraging low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, creators can maximize their revenue, eliminating the burden of excessive transaction costs.
Sovereignty in digital commerce means owning your infrastructure, not renting it.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Both Gumroad and Payhip provide limited ownership, with creators tied to their platforms and subject to their rules. In contrast, COREMERCH ensures that upon deployment, the creator owns everything—no subscriptions, no hidden fees, and no platform dependency. The automated system handles payment verification and file delivery, allowing creators to focus on their work rather than logistics. This level of infrastructure sovereignty is crucial for those who have been excluded from mainstream payment platforms, enabling them to build sustainable digital businesses.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators facing payment restrictions, the architecture you choose can define your success. Gumroad and Payhip may seem appealing, but their limitations can stifle growth. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is an optimal choice for those who want a scalable, reliable solution. With features like end-to-end testing and 30-day support, this stack provides a solid foundation for selling digital products without the anxiety of platform dependence.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid platform dependency—COREMERCH gives you full control over your sales.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
